EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
LOCAL GOVERNMENT (ADMINISTRATIVE AREA) ORDINANCE OF 265TH CHAPTER

I, P. B. Dissanayaka as the Governor of North Central Province, in terms of the powers vested in me under Paragraph (B) ofSection 02 of Local Government (Administrative Area) Ordinance of 265th Chapter and Sub section (01) of Section 32 ofProvincial Council Act, No. 42 of 1987 that should be read with paragraph (01)(a) of Section 02 of Provincial Council(Incidental Provision) Act, No. 12 of 1989 Mrs. M. P. D. P. Jayasinha, Sri Lanka Administrative Service Class III is appointedas Assistant Commissioner for said duties in Anuradhapura Administrative area with effect from 11.08.2014 until furthernotice.
P. B. DISSANAYAKA,Governor of the North Central Province.Governor’s Office of North Central Province,Anuradhapura,25th June 2016.
